scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @vertizoom/web" "npm run dev -w @vertizoom/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vertizoom/web && npm run build -w @vertizoom/database && npm run build -w @vertizoom/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @vertizoom/web && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @vertizoom/database && npm run typecheck -w @vertizoom/api
